recommended_actions.action: Investigate the order line with missing quantity to reconcile the correct quantity or flag the record in source systems.
Verify product-level counts for high-impact SKUs (PRODUCT_A, PRODUCT_B, PRODUCT_C) to ensure reported changes are not data artifacts.

Request or integrate the unsupported commercial metrics before making profitability or marketing budget decisions.
Monitor month-over-month trends for PRODUCT_C and PRODUCT_B in subsequent reporting periods to confirm persistence prior to operational changes.
